searchText: Tests reorganization. https://github.com/ethereum/tests/releases/tag/v17.0 It would be easier to work with these tarballs if they are organized as EEST: - single tarbal, - blockchain tests in `blockchain_tests`, - general state tests in `state_tests`, We're working on this right now 🙂 BTW, do they contain legacy² tests? with arbitrary folder names inside blockchain_tests and state_tests not yet. this is a test run to adjust CIs with releases tarballs Can be arbitrary dirs inside. I know projects partitioning the tests by type using the top-level directory name. Appreciate the feedback! This would be handy too. Maybe another tarbal? `fixtures_legacy_tests.tgz`? Using git clone to get tests on CI takes ~1 min. This should have us a lot. Dimitry, could you create the tarball to unpack as: ``` fixtures_ethereum_tests/.meta/index.json fixtures_ethereum_tests/state_tests/ # contains contents of GeneralizedStateTest fixtures_ethereum_tests/blockchain_tests/ # contains contents of BlockchainTests ``` You can include the tag in the diretory base name if you want. <@425274498732916736> how's this? <@393119312350543872> Let me know if you need more clarification! Looks good. This should allow us unify CI testing jobs: should be the same pattern with just URL different 🙂 <@547171287831805972> and .meta index build in the root so it has paths state_tests/test blockchain_tests/test ? I would like to do it that way. This will work for the pectra hive changes to run ethereum/tests blockchain tests. But, we need to fix `genindex` for state tests first. When I run the execution spec tests (v4.1.0) I always get the following error at the end: ``` Error loading fixtures from fixtures/blockchain_tests/byzantium/eip198_modexp_precompile/modexp/modexp.json /Users/daniel/projects/execution-spec-tests/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/_pytest/main.py:306: PluggyTeardownRaisedWarning: A plugin raised an exception during an old-style hookwrapper teardown. Plugin: terminalreporter, Hook: pytest_sessionfinish ``` It seems because of that the test report is not generated correctly. Does anybody know how to fix that?
